review.verdict: The warning-vs-shopping contrast reads, and the human/robot casting is correct, but the piece is undercut by missing/garbled components: the shared building is absent, the podium is nearly invisible, the shadow blends into the background, the doorway reads as a black box, and two elements clip the safe area — this needs another pass before publishing.
revisionNotes: Add the shared company building/roofline with a clock connecting both halves, as the brief specifies — it's missing entirely, so the 'same lab, same day' punchline doesn't land.

Recolor the 'shadow' robot darker (dark ink/charcoal at ~0.4-0.5 opacity) — at its current pale cream tone it nearly vanishes into the kraft background and reads as a ghost, not an ominous loom; also pull it inside the safe area (currently clipped x 76-644, y 20-799).
The 'podium' raw shape is effectively invisible, lost behind the shadow — bring it forward in z-order or give it a contrasting fill so the board member clearly stands at a podium.
Redesign the 'door' raw shape so it reads as an open doorway in profile (frame + gap), not a solid black rectangle boxing in the robot like a phone/TV bezel.
Shift 'bag' left ~80-100px so it sits fully inside the safe area; it's currently clipped at the right edge (x 946-1056).
Add the thin vertical seam divider from the brief between the two halves so the split reads intentionally instead of the figures blending together mid-frame.

review.verdict: The core doom-warning vs. cheerful-shopping contrast reads quickly and the cast/kindness are clean, but the unifying roofline reads as a barbell rather than a shared building, and the wallet/bag props float disconnected from the robot's hand, weakening the 'same lab, same day' punchline and the polish.
revisionNotes: Redesign the roofline/clock piece: right now it reads as a barbell or scale beam gripped overhead by the shadow's raised arms, not a shared rooftop — flatten it into a simple eave with a small clock tower so the 'same building' unity actually lands.

Attach the wallet and shopping bag to shopbot's hand instead of floating them to its right with visible gaps; set arms to 'raised' or remove the offset so the props read as held, not scattered debris.
Enlarge the wallet prop — the tiny red rectangle near the robot's shoulder is unreadable at a glance; use a distinct raw shape (fold + clasp) at a bigger scale.
Separate the podium silhouette from the board member's legs; the orange trapezoid currently fuses with the figure's lower body so the lectern isn't legible as a distinct prop.
Give the door more interior contrast (a lighter window panel) so it reads as an open doorway the robot is stepping through, not a dark frame caging it.
